integrity: The complete proof and exact standalone coefficient-rank checker are embedded. All source results used to motivate the comparison are credited, and finite tests are not substituted for a uniform proof.
scientific_limitations: Only odd-prime dihedral quandles over fields whose characteristic equals their order. No assertion for composite orders or unequal field characteristic. Independent expert validation has not occurred. Literature indexing may omit equivalent treatments.
